name: anas-phone
description: Provisional four-layer keypad cellular phone engineering study; incomplete and not fabrication-ready

scripts.test: node --import tsx tests/build.tsx && node --import tsx tests/interfaces.tsx && node --import tsx tests/firmware.ts && node --import tsx tests/keypad-clock.ts && node --import tsx tests/sms.ts && node --import tsx tests/pin-contracts.ts && npm run test:control

scripts.test:control: node --import tsx tests/power-policy.ts && node --import tsx tests/charge-qualification.ts && node --import tsx tests/modem-sequencer.ts && node --import tsx tests/system-shutdown-v16.ts
scripts.test:host: node --import tsx tests/firmware.ts && node --import tsx tests/keypad-clock.ts && node --import tsx tests/sms.ts && node --import tsx tests/pin-contracts.ts && npm run test:control
